questions.explanation: Nessler's reagent is a 2% solution of potassium tetraiodomercurate(II) in aqueous potassium hydroxide. Its chemical formula is <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.566ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="8.638ex" height="2.262ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -750 3818.1 1000" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="msub"><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="4B" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-4B"></use></g></g><g data-mml-node="mn" transform="translate(811,-150) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="32" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-32"></use></g></g><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(1214.6,0)"><use data-c="5B" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-5B"></use></g><g data-mml-node="msub" transform="translate(1492.6,0)"><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="48" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-48"></use><use data-c="67" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-67" transform="translate(750,0)"></use><use data-c="49" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-49" transform="translate(1250,0)"></use></g></g><g data-mml-node="mn" transform="translate(1644,-241.4) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="34" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-34"></use></g></g><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(3540.1,0)"><use data-c="5D" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-5D"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>. The elements present in it are Potassium (K), Mercury (Hg), and Iodine (I). Nitrogen (N) is not present in Nessler's reagent.
